verdict.rationale: Cognee ships a documented official MCP server explicitly enabling connections from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, Cline, and Codex, giving multiple off-the-shelf assistants access to the same underlying memory/knowledge graph via .remember/.recall operations, plus multi-user permission scoping so shared memory persists across tools. ChatGPT is not explicitly named among supported MCP clients and no independent hands-on report confirms cross-tool shared recall in practice. Missing for 10: explicit ChatGPT MCP support confirmation, independent/hands-on validation of cross-assistant shared memory working as described.
